title: Listening hours
statementMd:
Total listening time per listener in hours (sum of the played tracks' lengths), rounded to 2 decimals. Show the top five, ties by name.

Expected columns: `name`, `hours`.

Tables: `artists`, `albums`, `tracks`, `listeners`, `plays`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: Join plays to tracks and listeners.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT l.name, ROUND(SUM(t.seconds) / 3600.0, 2) AS hours FROM plays p JOIN tracks t ON t.id = p.track_id JOIN listeners l ON l.id = p.listener_id GROUP BY l.id, l.name ORDER BY hours DESC, l.name LIMIT 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
